question: In April 2025, at the National Federation Cup Athletics held at Maharaja's College Ground in Ernakulam, which Indian long jumper broke Anju Bobby George's 23-year-old national record with a jump of 6.64 m?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaili Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **April 2025**, the young Indian athlete **Shaili Singh** showcased an exceptional performance at the **National Federation Cup Athletics** championships.
 
• The event was hosted at the **Maharaja's College Ground** in **Ernakulam** (Kochi), **Kerala**, which is a historic venue for track and field events in India.
 
• **Shaili Singh** recorded a massive jump of **6.64 m**, which, according to the competition context, broke a **23-year-old** record previously held by the legendary **Anju Bobby George** at this specific meet. ***Hence, the statement regarding her record-breaking jump is correct.***
 
• She is a protégé of the **Anju Bobby George Foundation** and has been consistently performing at the highest domestic and international levels in the **Long Jump** category.
 
• The **National Federation Cup** serves as a critical selection trial for Indian athletes aiming for international assignments like the **Asian Athletics Championships** and the **World Athletics Championships**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shaili Singh:**
 
 
• Born on **January 7, 2004**, in **Jhansi**, **Uttar Pradesh**, she is considered one of the brightest prospects in Indian athletics.
 
• She is coached by **Robert Bobby George**, who is the husband and former coach of **Anju Bobby George**.
 
• In **2021**, she won the **Silver Medal** at the **World Athletics U20 Championships** held in **Nairobi**, **Kenya**, with a jump of **6.59 m**.
 
• Her personal best of **6.76 m** (achieved in **2023**) is the **second-longest** jump by an Indian woman, trailing only behind her mentor's national record.
 
 
 
• **Anju Bobby George:**
 
 
• She is the first Indian athlete to win a medal at the **World Championships in Athletics**, securing a **Bronze** in **Paris** in **2003**.
 
• Her national record of **6.83 m** was set at the **2004 Athens Olympics**, where she finished **fifth** (later upgraded to fourth).
 
• She was awarded the **Padma Shri** in **2004** and the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna** in **2003** for her contributions to sports.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options Analysis:**
 
 
• **Ancy Sojan:** A talented long jumper from **Kerala** who has been a close competitor to Shaili Singh, frequently crossing the **6.50 m** mark in domestic circuits.
 
• **Priyanka Goswami:** An Indian athlete who specializes in the **20 km Race Walk**. She represented India at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** and won a **Silver Medal** at the **2022 Commonwealth Games**.
 
• **D Sudha Singh:** An Indian Olympic athlete who competes in the **3000 m Steeplechase** event. She is an **Asian Games Gold medalist** (**2010 Guangzhou**) and a **two-time Olympian**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the venue:** The **Maharaja's College Ground** in **Ernakulam** is renowned for its synthetic track and has been a breeding ground for several international athletes from **Kerala**.
